verses.gurmukhi: ਲੋਚਨ ਪਤੰਗ ਦੀਪ ਦਰਸ ਦੇਖਨ ਗਏ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੁਨ ਊਤਰ ਨ ਆਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: lochan pata(n)g dheep dharas dhekhan ge jotee jot mil pun uootar na aane hai ||

en.bdb: The eyes of a moth who go for a glimpse of the flame of the lamp are never able to come back having engrossed themselves in its light. (So are the devoted disciples of the True Guru who are never able to return after a vision of Him).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਦ ਬਾਦ ਸੁਨਬੇ ਕਉ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਹਰਨ ਗਏ ਸੁਨਿ ਧੁਨਿ ਥਕਤ ਭਏ ਨ ਬਹੁਰਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naadh baadh sunabe kau sravan haran ge sun dhun thakat bhe na bahuraane hai ||

en.bdb: The ears of a deer gone to hear the melody of Ghanda Herha (a music instrument) gets so engrossed that he is never able to return. (So are the ears of a Sikh gone to hear ambrosial utterances of his True Guru never want to leave Him)

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਿਕ ਹੁਇ ਮਨ-ਮਧੁਕਰ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਸਮਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: charan kamal makara(n)dh ras rasik hui mana-madhukar sukh sa(n)paT samaane hai ||

en.bdb: Embellished with the sweet smelling dust of the lotus feet of the True Guru, the mind of an obedient disciple gets engrossed like the black bee entranced by the sweet smell of the flower.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੂਪ ਗੁਨ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮ ਪਦ ਆਨ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨ ਰਸ ਭਰਮ ਭੁਲਾਨੇ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੧॥
verses.translit_en: roop gun prem ras pooran param padh aan giaan dhiaan ras bharam bhulaane hai ||431||

en.bdb: By virtue of the loving merits of the Naam blessed by the radiant True Guru, a Sikh of the Guru attains supreme spiritual state and rejects all other worldly contemplations and awarenesses that put one in wandering of doubts.  (431)
